input_file.description: Path to the sed script file to be processed. If empty and no expression is provided, sedsed reads from stdin.

expression.description: Inline sed script expression to be processed. Mutually exclusive in intent with input_file for a single run, but can be combined.

quiet.description: Suppress automatic printing of pattern space.

mode.description: The operation mode for sedsed. Valid values: debug, indent, tokenize, htmlize.

hide_debug.description: List of debug information categories to hide (PATT, HOLD, COMM). Only valid in debug mode.

color.description: Show debug output in colors. Only relevant in debug mode.

dump_debug.description: Dump the debugged sed script to screen. Only relevant in debug mode.

indent_prefix.description: Indent prefix string for indent mode. Default is 4 spaces.
